@everyone

Dear Cornucopians,

The first of anything is a BIG deal, wouldn’t you agree?

From the start, we have been a community first project. Bringing all of you a seamless and cutting edge minting experience for our first NFT sale is something we, as a team, have taken VERY seriously. 

We’re trying to do big, seemingly impossible things, because we know we can. This strength of this community has brought the project as far as it is now, and we feel responsible for delivering the best possible minting experience in return. 

We want our first sale to be flawless in every way - an experience that will void you of frustration and bring you nothing but joy. We don’t want to rush a sale if it’s going to be a frustrating experience. No one wants to go into a sale and have failed transactions, or have something go wrong. 

Our community deserves better than that, and that is why we are delaying the Bubblejett Sprinter NFT mint.

Please read our team announcement here: https://medium.com/@COPI_Chronicle/user-experience-comes-first-cornucopias-opts-to-delay-upcoming-nft-sale-c92e18d2ccc6

A personal note from me (Matt): I encourage all of you to take this news and walk awaypositive.  We are in this together and negativity gets you nowhere. If someone in chat is upsetting you, simply kill them with kindness. We are a strong community, we are a kind community. We grow together through all the bumps and bruises along the way. 

Stay tuned for another announcement about our AMA on Thursday. Put on your thinking caps for some AMA questions! 

Thanks everyone!

@everyone

Key Mint Info: 
- There will be a quantity of 11,900 Bubblejetts
- Each Bubblejet will cost a total of 120 ADA - IMPORTANT - you will need to have extra ADA in your wallet for fees. 
- Allow 3 ada per sale to be safe, so:
        -  123 ada in wallet for 1 NFT or 
        -  243 ada for 2 NFTs or 
        -  363 ada for 3 NFTs.
- The extra 2 ADA and tx fee are used in the background to send the NFTs. If you start with 123 ADA, then 2 ADA and some change will remain in your wallet after 
   the sale
- This sale will be compatible with NAMI and CCVault wallets
- Max mint per tx is 3
- Cooldown is 15 minutes between mints
- NOT necessary to set collateral 

FAQ

Can we mint from a mobile phone?
No. At this time, it is required to mint from a computer.

Can someone mint, then change wallet and bypass the cooldown?
No. Our cooldowns are designed to block multiple mints. Even by changing your wallet, you will have to wait 15 minutes like everyone else to mint again.

If you are disconnected from the internet and move to a hotspot…
Your queue position will still be valid and you will be able to mint.

I got distracted and was not at my computer when my mint position became available…
If you missed your 15-minute window to mint, you will have to get back into the queue. Sorry! Please make sure you pay attention to your position and be ready to mint.

Is there a whitelist for this sale?
No. This is a 100% public sale.

Errors and failed transactions
If you experience an error or failed transaction, please double-check the following:

- Have you had any transactions 2 hours prior? Due to the recent congestion on the Cardano network, we advise you to use a wallet that has not been used for any 
   other transactions within the last 2 hours and to not proceed with any other transactions until your Bubblejett is confirmed in your wallet.
- Ensure you have enough ADA (plus dust) in your wallet
- Make sure you are NOT on the testnet
- Did you change wallets while in the queue? Don’t do that!

Basic Steps: 

1. Download Nami or CCVault desktop browser extension. Make sure you have the official one and not the scam.
2. Transfer enough ADA to cover NFT price and transaction fees. (see above)
3. Enter mint website: https://www.cornucopias.io/sprinter-nft-flash-sale/
4. When timer on the website runs out, click "Enter NFT Sale".
5. Wallet will prompt to connect to site.
6. Accept prompt.
7. Join queue and wait for the queue to reach your number.
8. Select quantity to buy.
9. Confirm.
10. Await for transaction confirmation.
11. Enjoy the pretty NFT reveal. (edited)

@everyone 

That was an intense first mint, but nothing's tougher than you, Corn Fam.

The overwhelming demand for the new generation of gaming NFTs from Cornucopias' metaverse impacted the smooth USER EXPERIENCE we spent so much time preparing for you. We learned a lot, especially about the true strength, enthusiasm, and determination of the Cornucopias community. 

There were so many Cornucopians slamming our system at once that the queue system was completely overloaded. At one point, our databases were hit with 60,000 API calls at once! The resulting bottleneck caused UI issues for some, and for this, we truly apologize. However, the system did not crash or go offline despite the tidal wave of activity. We immediately got onto a live call with our partners and formulated and implemented solutions in real-time. We were able to keep the sale moving along to clear the bottleneck and then accelerate to full speed until every last Bubblejett Sprinter found a new home. 

As you read this, 1st Edition Bubblejett Sprinter NFTs are already being listed and sold on secondary marketplaces for fabulous amounts of ADA. This indicates that the demand for our NFTs is extremely APE-ISHLY high. And that means that amazing things await our community and gaming metaverse.

Today, the Cornucopias community showed the internet what it could do, which is the best thing that could have happened to our metaverse project. The Derp & the Cornucopias team will work tirelessly to beef up our network's architecture and implement improvements to the system so that we can accommodate the extraordinary demand from our community for Cornucopias' revolutionary NFT gaming assets. 

The final speed of the mint was lightning-fast, and that's how it should have been from the beginning. We will get there on the next sale. 

We want to express our most sincere thanks to the community. Thank you for your enthusiasm and epic levels of patience. To those of you who survived the queue – you are the true LEGENDS. You are the MYTHIC diamond handers and HODLers who destroy FUD and make projects like ours succeed.  And a special thanks to Derp for resolving issues in real-time and all of their hard work getting us here.

Thank you. 

We can't wait to see your Bubblejetts flying around the game. 

For those of you who couldn't participate in this sale, the GTI (GraviTech Industries) Javlien FE 575 NFT sale is coming soon to a wallet near you! (edited)
